name: @jimzandueta/oowl
description: OpenCode Opinionated Workflow Layer — install and manage the OOWL multi-agent framework

scripts.test: node --import tsx/esm --test tests/lib/checksum.test.ts tests/lib/frontmatter.test.ts tests/lib/profiles.test.ts tests/lib/installer.test.ts tests/lib/opencode-scanner.test.ts tests/lib/skill-recommender.test.ts tests/lib/opencode-config-writer.ts tests/commands/init.test.ts tests/commands/update.test.ts tests/framework/invariants.test.ts
scripts.smoke:cli: node bin/oowl.js --help && node bin/oowl.js --version && node bin/oowl.js badcmd || test $? -eq 1
scripts.ci: npm test && npm run smoke:cli && npm run pack:check
